title: Infrastructure advisor PoC
notice: Read-only advisor. FAKE / TEST is a local deterministic demonstration. External processing requires an approved provider and your separate consent.
commands: Test commands: summary; room trade_1; room trading @0 (zero-based shift); list title; compare leftID rightID. List duplicate titles first, then select explicit IDs.
question: Question
processingError: External processing is unavailable. Sign in and reopen the panel to check your consent.
fake_test: FAKE / TEST — local demonstration; no external model.
external_unavailable: External provider unavailable: processing approval or deployment requirements are not satisfied. No business context is sent.
consent_outdated: The privacy policy or provider terms have changed. Review and consent again.
consent_revoked: Consent withdrawn. Future external processing is blocked.
ready: External processing enabled with your current consent.
processingPurpose: The external model understands your question, selects read-only tools and explains their minimized results.
processingData: May send: your question, necessary schedule summaries, queried room assignments and production facts, saved-plan titles, update times and deterministic differences. Saved-plan IDs use temporary aliases.
processingExcluded: Never include credentials in your question. Cookies, API keys, Skland credentials, complete Operator Box, raw logs and internal diagnostics are excluded from context payloads.
processingWithdrawal: Optional: declining leaves core features available. Withdrawal blocks future sends; it does not delete information already processed by a provider.
providerLink: Provider information (not proof of processing approval)
previewLimitation: Uses fixed synthetic solver outputs to validate the engineering flow; not evidence of real production, feasibility or optimality. Real business egress remains blocked.
